translations.Choose which apps the NL Design theme ap: Wählen Sie, für welche Apps das NL-Design-Theme gilt. Wird eine App abgewählt, werden ihre Seiten im Standard-Nextcloud-Stil dargestellt, einschließlich der Kopfzeile auf diesen Seiten.

translations.A record of theming configuration change: A record of theming configuration changes: who changed what, from what, to what, and when. Useful evidence for accessibility audits.
translations.Map Nextcloud groups to token sets so di: Map Nextcloud groups to token sets so different gemeenten sharing one instance each see their own house style. Row order is priority order: for a user in multiple mapped groups, the first matching row wins.
translations.Logo, mail templates, and other Nextclou: Logo, mail templates, and other Nextcloud core branding always follow the instance default token set above — they are not per-group. Only this token-set stylesheet layer differs per group.

translations.Brand password-reset, share-notification: Brand password-reset, share-notification, and other system emails with the active token set's color and logo. If nldesign is later disabled, Nextcloud automatically falls back to the stock email template — mail is never blocked by this setting.

translations.Only upload fonts your organization hold: Only upload fonts your organization holds a license to self-host. Licensing responsibility rests with the uploader.
translations.Upload a WOFF2 font file (max 2 MB, 20 f: Upload a WOFF2 font file (max 2 MB, 20 fonts max) and assign it to the body text or heading role. Uploaded fonts are self-hosted — no external requests.

translations.Optionally check once a day whether the: Optionally check once a day whether the upstream NL Design System themes have new tokens. This is the only outbound network request this app makes; it contacts api.github.com and never applies anything automatically — you always review and apply updates yourself.
translations.Check daily for upstream token updates (: Check daily for upstream token updates (contacts api.github.com)

translations.Theme published instance-wide. Reload th: Theme published instance-wide. Reload the page to see changes.
translations.Download or upload the complete NL Desig: Download or upload the complete NL Design configuration as one JSON file — the active token set, toggles, per-app exclusions, token overrides, custom token sets, email footer, and the upstream-update toggle. Use this to promote configuration between dev, test, acceptance, and production environments identically. This is different from the overrides-only download above.
translations.This token set also ships a dark-surface: This token set also ships a dark-surface logo. Nextcloud core has no dark logo slot, so it is applied by nldesign's own dark-mode stylesheet, not synced to Nextcloud theming.
translations.Enable dark mode variants for the active: Enable dark mode variants for the active token set
translations.When enabled, a generated dark-mode styl: When enabled, a generated dark-mode stylesheet follows whichever Nextcloud dark/light/system theme is already active — it never changes your Nextcloud theme choice itself.
translations.Marianne is the official typeface of the: Marianne is the official typeface of the French State and is reserved for French State administrations. Enable it only if your organisation is a French State agency. Otherwise Inter is used.
translations.Our organisation is a French State agenc: Our organisation is a French State agency (administration de l'État)
translations.Source: admin override (occ config:app:s: Source: admin override (occ config:app:set nldesign icon_pack)
translations.This only switches the icon assets nldes: This only switches the icon assets nldesign itself serves through imagePath. It does not replace Nextcloud's built-in core icons beyond what the active theme's CSS already restyles.

translations.This set does not define every token the: This set does not define every token the design system reads, so the missing ones fall back to the Rijkshuisstijl defaults instead of this brand.

translations.Stock Nextcloud means Nextcloud's own co: Stock Nextcloud means Nextcloud's own colours and logo. Everything Thematiq synced into Nextcloud theming is undone; the token set itself is already applied.
translations.Also reset Nextcloud theming to its defa: Also reset Nextcloud theming to its defaults (login page, e-mails, mobile apps)
